reviews.review:
This game has a lot of potential and plays seamlessly even in this early access stage.  You truly need to work as a team in order to get all of the resources, so there's no solo carrying the team, which is a nice change.

But be warned, there is very little content right now.  Every mission I do is almost identical, you just mine morkite.  Very few enemy variations, an upgrade system which isn't very rewarding.  As the game gets more content, I'm sure it will be much more fun.

12/3/18 Edit:

Ugh, I want to like this game so much, but it is just not that fun at the moment because every dig  is basically the same thing over and over again.  Yes, its procedurally generated, so the giant cave has some different tunnels every time, woop de do.  The bugs are all the same, each class only has 4 unique weapons/gadgets so they get repetitive real quick.  I still will leave it as recommended, but its probably only about a 6/10 for me.

This is the best Early Access game Ive ever seen, and potentially one of the best games Ive ever played. The atmosphere is great and each class is extremely unique. Cooperation is definitely important for high difficulties. Let's hope the developer keeping their good works!

[h1]Left 4 Dead, No Man's Sky & Minecraft had a Dwarf baby.[/h1]
